scope: Smallest 33 x 36 mm board only; documentation and necessity audit, no CAD edits.

required.label: Keep function
required.meaning: Essential in the current circuit topology. Equivalent redesign is possible; this is not a claim that the exact manufacturer part is uniquely necessary.

architecture.label: Depends on system choice
architecture.meaning: Required by the currently chosen rail, clock, boot or connector strategy. Remove or replace only with an explicit alternative architecture.

qualification.label: Check before reducing
qualification.meaning: Supports supply quality, startup, signal quality or tuning. Its exact quantity/value is not proven minimal; removal requires relevant analysis or measurements.

nonessential.label: Removal candidate
nonessential.meaning: No current functional consumer was found for the feature. Deliberately remove/review its branch and recheck CAD, rather than simply depopulating series links.

components.whyNeeded: 47 uF at the proposed 12 V cable entry supports slower input current changes before the individual converter input reservoirs.
components.ifRemoved: Reduces cable-entry energy reserve; depends on cable impedance, inrush and source behavior.
components.reviewDecision: Do not call this input protection. Retain pending a source/cable transient study; optimize jointly with the carrier, not by visual whitespace.

components.whyNeeded: 100 nF from the cable input to GND bypasses faster voltage disturbance at entry.
components.ifRemoved: Changes entry-node high-frequency impedance.
components.reviewDecision: Review jointly with C1 and converter input loops. It does not clamp overvoltage.

components.whyNeeded: Local input reservoir from LINK_12V to GND next to U2. Supplies the converter switching loop.
components.ifRemoved: The local current loop relies on distant capacitors and cable inductance; input ripple and unstable startup become possible.
components.reviewDecision: Keep a qualified local input-capacitance function. Actual capacitance at 12 V, tolerance, temperature and aging must meet the input requirement.

components.whyNeeded: Small local 100 nF bypass across U2 input, alongside C3.
components.ifRemoved: Changes high-frequency input impedance. The larger capacitor may not behave identically at fast edges.
components.reviewDecision: A possible optimization only after checking switching-loop layout, impedance and EMI; not proven individually indispensable.

components.whyNeeded: Local output reservoir and voltage-sense pickup for U2; the L/C output function works with L1.
components.ifRemoved: The output filter and sensed node lose their intended local capacitor; supply ripple and control behavior change.
components.reviewDecision: Keep a qualified local output capacitor. C5 and C9 remain upstream of R9 and R122 respectively.

pins.status: assigned net connected in native DRC

components.whyNeeded: 10 nF from U2 SS/TR to GND controls the rail rise time. It is a timing choice, not the source of rail power.
components.ifRemoved: The converter uses its fast internal startup behavior; inrush and FPGA rail ramp/sequence change.
components.reviewDecision: Could be reduced or omitted only after measured startup remains within FPGA ramp and sequencing limits. Retain until those checks pass.

components.whyNeeded: 330u 2.5V polymer ESR25m bulk energy reserve for FPGA core between VCCINT_1V0 and GND. Supplies short current pulses locally while the regulator and plane respond.
components.ifRemoved: Less local stored charge and changed power-network impedance; may cause supply noise or transient failures. Removing one is not automatically safe or automatically fatal.
components.reviewDecision: Retain the documented decoupling baseline. This individual part is not proven to be the unique minimum; reduction requires equivalent impedance, effective capacitance and load-step evidence.

components.reviewDecision: Retain the documented decoupling baseline. This individual part is not proven to be the unique minimum; reduction requires equivalent impedance, effective capacitance and load-step evidence. The recorded part family is NRND; qualify an orderable alternative.
